During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[DM/C3]] was fitted with '''EM analyzers''' that were able to penetrate disguises, such as revealing a [[Human/Legends|Human]] was posing as an [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]].
